questions.question: What is homogenization of milk? Explain the process and give two advantages. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• What is homogenization of milk? Explain the process and give two advantages. [K]/[CO2]
  • Homogenization of milk: It is the process of breaking down large fat globules in milk into
  • smaller, uniformly distributed particles to prevent cream separation.
  • Process & advantages: Milk is forced under high pressure through narrow openings to
  • reduce fat globule size; this improves digestibility and gives milk a smooth, uniform
  • texture.

questions.question: Explain egg white foam formation – mention the stages of foam formation and any two factors affecting foam stability. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain egg white foam formation – mention the stages of foam formation and any two
  • factors affecting foam stability. [K]/[CO2]
  • Egg white foam formation involves stages such as foamy, soft peak, stiff peak, and overbeaten
  • stage due to protein denaturation and air incorporation. (2 marks).
  • Foam stability is affected by factors like presence of fat (reduces stability) and addition of sugar or
  • acid (improves stability). (2 marks).
